sources: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Meenambakkam & Nungambakkam Observatories
Public Works Department (PWD) Water Resources Organization Chembarambakkam Gauge
Tamil Nadu State Disaster Management Authority (TNSDMA) Report 2015
description: Record-breaking 24-hour deluge (494 mm recorded at Tambaram/Meenambakkam, exceeding all 100-year monthly averages) compounded by simultaneous 29,000 cusecs emergency release from Chembarambakkam Reservoir into the Adyar River basin. Submerged Saidapet Bridge, Velachery, Chennai Airport runway/GST Road, and Kotturpuram under 1.5-3.0 meters of water.
